78   def pbEORUseFutureSight(position, position_index)
   79     return if !position || position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightCounter] == 0
   80     position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightCounter] -= 1
   81     return if position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightCounter] > 0
   82     return if !@battlers[position_index] || @battlers[position_index].fainted?   # No target
   83     moveUser = nil
   84     allBattlers.each do |battler|
   85       next if battler.opposes?(position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightUserIndex])
   86       next if battler.pokemonIndex != position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightUserPartyIndex]
   87       moveUser = battler
   88       break
   89     end
   90     return if moveUser && moveUser.index == position_index   # Target is the user
   91     if !moveUser   # User isn't in battle, get it from the party
   92       party = pbParty(position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightUserIndex])
   93       pkmn = party[position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightUserPartyIndex]]
   94       if pkmn&.able?
   95         moveUser = Battler.new(self, position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightUserIndex])
   96         moveUser.pbInitDummyPokemon(pkmn, position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightUserPartyIndex])
   97       end
   98     end
   99     return if !moveUser   # User is fainted
  100     move = position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightMove]
  101     pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} took the {2} attack!", @battlers[position_index].pbThis,
  102                     GameData::Move.get(move).name))
  103     # NOTE: Future Sight failing against the target here doesn't count towards
  104     #       Stomping Tantrum.
  105     userLastMoveFailed = moveUser.lastMoveFailed
  106     @futureSight = true
  107     moveUser.pbUseMoveSimple(move, position_index)
  108     @futureSight = false
  109     moveUser.lastMoveFailed = userLastMoveFailed
  110     @battlers[position_index].pbFaint if @battlers[position_index].fainted?
  111     position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightCounter]        = 0
  112     position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightMove]           = nil
  113     position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightUserIndex]      = -1
  114     position.effects[PBEffects::FutureSightUserPartyIndex] = -1
  115   end

  120   def pbEORWishHealing
  121     @positions.each_with_index do |pos, idxPos|
  122       next if !pos || pos.effects[PBEffects::Wish] == 0
  123       pos.effects[PBEffects::Wish] -= 1
  124       next if pos.effects[PBEffects::Wish] > 0
  125       next if !@battlers[idxPos] || !@battlers[idxPos].canHeal?
  126       wishMaker = pbThisEx(idxPos, pos.effects[PBEffects::WishMaker])
  127       @battlers[idxPos].pbRecoverHP(pos.effects[PBEffects::WishAmount])
  128       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s wish came true!", wishMaker))
  129     end
  130   end

  135   def pbEORSeaOfFireDamage(priority)
  136     2.times do |side|
  137       next if sides[side].effects[PBEffects::SeaOfFire] == 0
  138       sides[side].effects[PBEffects::SeaOfFire] -= 1
  139       next if sides[side].effects[PBEffects::SeaOfFire] == 0
  140       pbCommonAnimation("SeaOfFire") if side == 0
  141       pbCommonAnimation("SeaOfFireOpp") if side == 1
  142       priority.each do |battler|
  143         next if battler.opposes?(side)
  144         next if !battler.takesIndirectDamage? || battler.pbHasType?(:FIRE)
  145         @scene.pbDamageAnimation(battler)
  146         battler.pbTakeEffectDamage(battler.totalhp / 8, false) do |hp_lost|
  147           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is hurt by the sea of fire!", battler.pbThis))
  148         end
  149       end
  150     end
  151   end

  170     # Aqua Ring
  171     priority.each do |battler|
  172       next if !battler.effects[PBEffects::AquaRing]
  173       next if !battler.canHeal?
  174       hpGain = battler.totalhp / 16

  176       battler.pbRecoverHP(hpGain)
  177       pbDisplay(_INTL("Aqua Ring restored {1}'s HP!", battler.pbThis(true)))
  178     end
  179     # Ingrain
  180     priority.each do |battler|
  181       next if !battler.effects[PBEffects::Ingrain]
  182       next if !battler.canHeal?
  183       hpGain = battler.totalhp / 16
  184       hpGain = (hpGain * 1.3).floor if battler.hasActiveItem?(:BIGROOT)
  185       battler.pbRecoverHP(hpGain)
  186       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} absorbed nutrients with its roots!", battler.pbThis))
  187     end
  188     # Leech Seed
  189     priority.each do |battler|
  190       next if battler.effects[PBEffects::LeechSeed] < 0
  191       next if !battler.takesIndirectDamage?
  192       recipient = @battlers[battler.effects[PBEffects::LeechSeed]]
  193       next if !recipient || recipient.fainted?
  194       pbCommonAnimation("LeechSeed", recipient, battler)
  195       battler.pbTakeEffectDamage(battler.totalhp / 8) do |hp_lost|
  196         recipient.pbRecoverHPFromDrain(hp_lost, battler,
  197                                        _INTL("{1}'s health is sapped by Leech Seed!", battler.pbThis))
  198         recipient.pbAbilitiesOnDamageTaken
  199       end
  200       recipient.pbFaint if recipient.fainted?
  201     end

  204   #=============================================================================

  207   def pbEORStatusProblemDamage(priority)
  208     # Damage from poisoning
  209     priority.each do |battler|
  210       next if battler.fainted?
  211       next if battler.status != :POISON
  212       if battler.statusCount > 0
  213         battler.effects[PBEffects::Toxic] += 1
  214         battler.effects[PBEffects::Toxic] = 16 if battler.effects[PBEffects::Toxic] > 16
  215       end
  216       if battler.hasActiveAbility?(:POISONHEAL)
  217         if battler.canHeal?
  218           anim_name = GameData::Status.get(:POISON).animation
  219           pbCommonAnimation(anim_name, battler) if anim_name
  220           pbShowAbilitySplash(battler)
  221           battler.pbRecoverHP(battler.totalhp / 8)
  222           if Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  223             pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s HP was restored.", battler.pbThis))
  224           else
  225             pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} restored its HP.", battler.pbThis, battler.abilityName))
  226           end
  227           pbHideAbilitySplash(battler)
  228         end
  229       elsif battler.takesIndirectDamage?
  230         battler.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
  231         dmg = battler.totalhp / 8
  232         dmg = battler.totalhp * battler.effects[PBEffects::Toxic] / 16 if battler.statusCount > 0
  233         battler.pbContinueStatus { battler.pbReduceHP(dmg, false) }
  234         battler.pbItemHPHealCheck
  235         battler.pbAbilitiesOnDamageTaken
  236         battler.pbFaint if battler.fainted?
  237         battler.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
  238       end
  239     end
  240     # Damage from burn
  241     priority.each do |battler|
  242       next if battler.status != :BURN || !battler.takesIndirectDamage?
  243       battler.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
  244       dmg = (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7) ? battler.totalhp / 16 : battler.totalhp / 8
  245       dmg = (dmg / 2.0).round if battler.hasActiveAbility?(:HEATPROOF)
  246       battler.pbContinueStatus { battler.pbReduceHP(dmg, false) }
  247       battler.pbItemHPHealCheck
  248       battler.pbAbilitiesOnDamageTaken
  249       battler.pbFaint if battler.fainted?
  250       battler.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
  251     end
  252   end

  288   def pbEORTrappingDamage(battler)
  289     return if battler.fainted? || battler.effects[PBEffects::Trapping] == 0
  290     battler.effects[PBEffects::Trapping] -= 1
  291     move_name = GameData::Move.get(battler.effects[PBEffects::TrappingMove]).name
  292     if battler.effects[PBEffects::Trapping] == 0
  293       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was freed from {2}!", battler.pbThis, move_name))
  294       return
  295     end
  296     anim = TRAPPING_MOVE_COMMON_ANIMATIONS[battler.effects[PBEffects::TrappingMove]] || "Wrap"
  297     pbCommonAnimation(anim, battler)
  298     return if !battler.takesIndirectDamage?
  299     hpLoss = (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6) ? battler.totalhp / 8 : battler.totalhp / 16
  300     if @battlers[battler.effects[PBEffects::TrappingUser]].hasActiveItem?(:BINDINGBAND)
  301       hpLoss = (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6) ? battler.totalhp / 6 : battler.totalhp / 8
  302     end
  303     @scene.pbDamageAnimation(battler)
  304     battler.pbTakeEffectDamage(hpLoss, false) do |hp_lost|
  305       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is hurt by {2}!", battler.pbThis, move_name))
  306     end
  307   end

  312   def pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, effect)
  313     priority.each do |battler|
  314       next if battler.fainted? || battler.effects[effect] == 0
  315       battler.effects[effect] -= 1
  316       yield battler if block_given? && battler.effects[effect] == 0
  317     end
  318   end

  320   def pbEOREndBattlerEffects(priority)
  321     # Taunt
  322     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::Taunt) do |battler|
  323       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s taunt wore off!", battler.pbThis))
  324     end
  325     # Encore
  326     priority.each do |battler|
  327       next if battler.fainted? || battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore] == 0
  328       idxEncoreMove = battler.pbEncoredMoveIndex
  329       if idxEncoreMove >= 0
  330         battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore] -= 1
  331         if battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore] == 0 || battler.moves[idxEncoreMove].pp == 0
  332           battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore] = 0
  333           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s encore ended!", battler.pbThis))
  334         end
  335       else
  336         PBDebug.log("[End of effect] #{battler.pbThis}'s encore ended (encored move no longer known)")
  337         battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore]     = 0
  338         battler.effects[PBEffects::EncoreMove] = nil
  339       end
  340     end
  341     # Disable/Cursed Body
  342     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::Disable) do |battler|
  343       battler.effects[PBEffects::DisableMove] = nil
  344       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is no longer disabled!", battler.pbThis))
  345     end
  346     # Magnet Rise
  347     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::MagnetRise) do |battler|
  348       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s electromagnetism wore off!", battler.pbThis))
  349     end
  350     # Telekinesis
  351     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::Telekinesis) do |battler|
  352       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was freed from the telekinesis!", battler.pbThis))
  353     end
  354     # Heal Block
  355     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::HealBlock) do |battler|
  356       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s Heal Block wore off!", battler.pbThis))
  357     end
  358     # Embargo
  359     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::Embargo) do |battler|
  360       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} can use items again!", battler.pbThis))
  361       battler.pbItemTerrainStatBoostCheck
  362     end
  363     # Yawn
  364     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::Yawn) do |battler|
  365       if battler.pbCanSleepYawn?
  366         PBDebug.log("[Lingering effect] #{battler.pbThis} fell asleep because of Yawn")
  367         battler.pbSleep
  368       end
  369     end
  370     # Perish Song
  371     perishSongUsers = []
  372     priority.each do |battler|
  373       next if battler.fainted? || battler.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] == 0
  374       battler.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] -= 1
  375       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s perish count fell to {2}!", battler.pbThis, battler.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong]))
  376       if battler.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] == 0
  377         perishSongUsers.push(battler.effects[PBEffects::PerishSongUser])
  378         battler.pbReduceHP(battler.hp)
  379       end
  380       battler.pbItemHPHealCheck
  381       battler.pbFaint if battler.fainted?
  382     end
  383     # Judge if all remaining Pokemon fainted by a Perish Song triggered by a single side
  384     if perishSongUsers.length > 0 &&
  385        ((perishSongUsers.find_all { |idxBattler| opposes?(idxBattler) }.length == perishSongUsers.length) ||
  386        (perishSongUsers.find_all { |idxBattler| !opposes?(idxBattler) }.length == perishSongUsers.length))
  387       pbJudgeCheckpoint(@battlers[perishSongUsers[0]])
  388     end
  389     return if @decision > 0
  390   end
